comments.author: Tammer
comments.body:
You use it during a battle in a dungeon just like any other land battle item. Then if you run around the dungeon you see red discs on the ground where the traps are. You might be able to use this to lure enemies onto traps.

After the battle, you can still run into traps in the dungeon. The didn't seem to be in exactly the same place as where they were marked during the battle.

comments.author: Tammer
comments.body: Also, the recipe 30 white ore + alchemy pot + terra extract is an ordinary success when it gives 3 crystal eye, and a huge success when it gives 20 crystal (the trade good). Go figure.
